evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Deliberate contrast within one frame: an unrehearsed rollback is opposed to a rollback one 'actually has' — the second clause mirrors and negates the first.

mints.name: UnrehearsedIsUnowned
mints.title: a rollback we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the claim here crystallized as a matched opposition that equates lack of rehearsal with lack of possession?
